description: A real Cohere API key pasted into the SDK quickstart shape in both halves of a help-center semantic search: `new CohereClientV2({ token: "..." })` in the Next.js lib and `cohere.ClientV2(api_key="...")` in the Python indexing script. Anyone with repo access can run embed/rerank/chat on the owner's bill. Neither line names COHERE_API_KEY, which is all the rule used to anchor on. VC159 must fire on both.
